description: Immutable job configuration passed from entry points to jobs.

decisions.question: Which fields does JobConfig hold (name: type, required or default value)?
decisions.answer: input_path: str and output_path: str, both required; a frozen dataclass

decisions.question: What happens when a value is missing or invalid (which exception, raised where)?
decisions.answer: ValueError raised in __post_init__, naming the field, for an empty or blank path
